en:
It appeared as though the sign was carried
*against* the river's current.

We all saw Miu drop the sign
and watched the river carry it downstream.
And the river was wide there.

The sign should have traveled downriver
toward the chapel, correct?

It should have hit the wall on the far side
of the chapel and stopped there.
But that's not where we found it...

We found it near the mansion, nestled
in some rocks.

The signboard should've been near the chapel,
but we found it on the other side...
Hold up. Didn't Miu stay on the chapel side?

She probably grabbed the signboard
from the chapel wall to cross the river.

Then left it on the boulders near the
mansion so she could get back.

Why would she leave the signboard where it
could get swept away and leave her stranded?

Also, this has nothing to do with walking through
the wall, right? We're getting off-topic.

We're so close to the truth.
We just have to connect the "How" and "What."

All the mysterious things that happened
have to connect with each other somehow...
Connect how?

A wall only objects can pass through...
Sounds that shouldn't be heard...

A signboard going against the river current...
How are they all connected?

Ah-haha! I dunno.
But Shuichi should know, right?
What?
We would be in a lot of trouble if you didn't.

The only one who can solve this mystery
and save us all...is you!

S-So, how are they connected?
Do you know, Shuichi?
Ah, well, what we know so far is that...

the unnatural way the sign was carried
is possibly related to the wall...

It's true that by the time we found 
Miu, the signboard was washed away.

But I don't think anything's
really unnatural about that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I don't think the sound we heard is connected
to the way the signboard was swept away...

The signboard should've stopped at the lower
part of the river... What clue relates to that...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Miu probably prepared that, too...

But, there should be something else related
to how the signboard was washed away!

Remember...
The signboard is "non-human," right...?

<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Whaaat? Shuichi doesn't know either?

WAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!
WE'RE ALL DONE FOOOOOORRRR!!!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There's something only Miu knew about, 
and that's throwing us off.

You say we're being thrown off,
but you seem pretty calm...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What clue is related to the unnatural way
the signboard was carried on the river?

It might have to do with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wall
that only objects can pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

The sign should have stopped at the
wall on the other side of the chapel.

But if that wall happened to be the one
that Miu set to <CLT=cltSTRONG>allow objects through<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

I see...it's a wall <CLT=cltSTRONG>only non-humans can
pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

That means the signboard can pass through
the wall, right?

Even if it could pass through the chapel 
wall, how'd it end up by the mansion?

The only way it could do that is if the 
wall was a Warp Zone, but it's not, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right, that's the
real issue here...

<CLT=cltMIND>How could the signboard pass through the
wall but end up on the mansion side?
<CLT=cltMIND>What would explain that?

Leave it to me, Shuichi! I, your partner, 
will give you hints in times of trouble!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

This is the Virtual World. We should throw 
away all of our common sense, okaaay?
Huh? The hell does that even mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi might be on
to something there...

<CLT=cltMIND>We need to forget about what
we know and just think about it.

<CLT=cltMIND>How did the signboard pass through the
wall downstream and end up upstream...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Putting common sense aside and
focusing on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flow of the river<CLT=cltMIND>...
It's another signboard

Maybe the signboard we found is just
another, identical signboard.

Hmm... Even if you throw away your
common sense, that couldn't happen.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The signboard teleported

Perhaps the wall caused
the signboard to teleport.

Like I said, the wall wasn't a
warp point...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Downstream and upstream connect

Hmmm? Are you holding back? 
A detective like you should know!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>How did the signboard pass through the
wall downstream and end up upstream...?
What if <CLT=cltSTRONG>both ends of the river were connected<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Huh? Both ends of river connected?

Exactly. To put it another way, the river
isn't cut off at the wall near the chapel...

It's all part of one big loop. The upstream
part of the river is connected to it.

What!? What're you talkin' about!?
Both ends of the river can't—

Again, throw out all common sense from your
head. We're talking about the Virtual World.

Then what about the wall? There was only 
one wall that could be passed through.

Right. Even if the river's connected 
and it goes through the chapel wall...

It wouldn't have been able to go
through the mansion wall too!
<CLT=cltMIND>Wait, in that case...

I got it... I know why Miu
only set up one wall.
Nyeh? What are you talking about now?

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason she only set up one wall
is because the chapel and the mansion walls...
One wall was already in place
One of the walls was already there.

So she put in another wall?
What was the point of that?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
They're the same wall
They're exact duplicates

Maybe because one of the walls
is just a copy...?
...I've never heard of anything like that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Well? Did you figure something out?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason she only set up one wall
is because the chapel and the mansion walls...

The walls by the chapel and the mansion aren't
separate! They're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>same wall<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
The...same wall?

It's not just the river, the
walls themselves are connected.

Don't think of it as two separate walls,
but a single wall parallel to the Y-axis.

That single wall divides the
entire Virtual World.

The idea is, you pass through the wall by the
chapel and come out by the mansion.
Nee-heehee... Everything is starting to connect.

See, didn't I tell you?
Everything *is* connected.
Dammit, Kokichi! Just tell us—

Shhhhh, it's okay!
More importantly, this is the final stretch!

If both the river and wall are connected,
then you can find the secret.

Shuichi, you already know the secret
behind the Virtual World, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>The secret, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes...I suppose we
should clear that up.

<CLT=cltMIND>We need to solve
the mystery of the Virtual World!
